scenes.subject: Foot-level view across a white-hot school courtyard: a line of children holding hands, none casting a shadow, a trail of wet bare footprints in front

layers.foreground: wet bare footprints evaporating on hot cracked concrete
layers.midground: line of schoolchildren holding hands in a shallow arc
layers.background: whitewashed school wall, neem tree, blown-out sky

scenes.light_source: noon sun at the zenith, bleached flat light with sun glare
scenes.motion: slow low dolly along the trail, heat shimmer, footprints fading in sequence
details: wet footprints with toes and heel
ZERO SHADOW DAY stamp fading out
children's contact shadows reduced to faint dots
scenes.camera: low dolly forward along the footprint trail with a slow handheld drift
scenes.sound_cue: cicada drone + loo wind from frame one, nothing else

scenes.subject: Dark mud-plaster kitchen, Dadi's silhouette rim-lit by the blown-out doorway, then her old hand letting go of the boy's wrist

layers.foreground: dust motes drifting in the light shaft
layers.midground: Dadi's silhouette with hair bun, the boy small in the foreground
layers.background: shelf of steel thalis, matka, chulha embers glowing

scenes.light_source: blinding white doorway on the right, ember glow on the left
scenes.motion: slow push-in, embers pulse, dust drifts, her fingers loosen on the wrist
details: wrinkled hand with gold and red bangles
scenes.camera: slow push-in with a tiny handheld sway, then a tight push on the hands
scenes.sound_cue: muffled cicadas through the doorway, ember crackles, bangles jingle as she lets go

scenes.subject: Courtyard from a rising crane: master ji lines the children up and makes them hold hands by a chalk arc, the rope-fenced well behind

layers.midground: children walking into a line, master ji gesturing
layers.background: rope-fenced well, neem tree and school wall

scenes.light_source: hard noon sun, shadows still long and shrinking
scenes.motion: crane rising and turning toward the well, children walking into formation
details: children's long shadows pointing toward the camera
barred windows and a gate arch
scenes.camera: crane up and turn toward the well, handheld
scenes.sound_cue: far school bell, shuffling feet, chalk scrape, cicadas swelling

scenes.subject: Overhead view of the arc of children holding hands as every shadow retreats into their feet and a thirteenth head appears at the end of the line

layers.foreground: paving cracks and stains seen from above
layers.midground: arc of children's heads and shoulders joined by hands
layers.background: round well mouth with a black centre

scenes.light_source: sun overhead, flat bleaching light that blooms
scenes.motion: camera drifts down and rotates, shadows shrink one by one, the sun glare blooms
details: damp ring under the new head
scenes.withheld: how the extra child got there
scenes.camera: overhead drift down with a slow rotate
scenes.sound_cue: cicadas and a rising ring that cut dead as the last shadow goes

scenes.subject: Extreme close-up: a warm small hand held by a pale grey wet hand, steam rising off the skin in the heat

layers.midground: two clasped hands, water beads on the grey one
layers.background: blown-out hot stone with heat bokeh

scenes.motion: slow push-in, steam rises, drops fall from the knuckles
details: pale grey wet hand with bluish nails
shirt cuff of the other child
scenes.withheld: the face of the one holding on
scenes.sound_cue: total dead zone: sub pressure, a heartbeat, a wet grip

scenes.subject: Raju's wet-haired face bowed in the glare, a drop forming at a strand and falling onto hot stone

layers.midground: Raju's bowed head and wet fringe

scenes.motion: slow push-in, the drop forms falls and sizzles into steam in a loop
details: collar of a soaked white shirt
scenes.camera: slow push-in on the face, handheld
scenes.sound_cue: dripping onto hot stone with a sizzle, heartbeat rising

scenes.subject: Close-up of Raju's face in total silence, his eyes slowly opening on the last word of the whisper

layers.background: white glare with a dark edge vignette

scenes.light_source: hard white backlight with a dark rim vignette
scenes.motion: slow push-in, his mouth moves, eyes lift open on the last words
scenes.sound_cue: a true silence, then a sub thud, the whisper and a stinger as his eyes open

scenes.subject: Wide courtyard: the wind and cicadas return, shadows grow back from every pair of feet, the narrator breathes out beside a pale boy

layers.foreground: long returning shadows on the ground
layers.midground: narrator and the pale boy at the end of the line

scenes.light_source: afternoon sun dropping to a lower angle
scenes.motion: camera creeps in, shadows regrow, leaves move, shimmer
details: shadows growing back from the feet
pale boy at the end of the line
scenes.withheld: that the shadow is not the narrator's
scenes.camera: creeping handheld move toward the pair
scenes.sound_cue: wind and cicadas return in a gust, murmur of children

scenes.subject: High-angle view of the two boys: the narrator steps back and his shadow stays and slides to the pale boy's feet

layers.foreground: long ground shadows toward the camera
layers.midground: narrator stepping back, the pale boy standing still

scenes.motion: camera drifts down, the narrator steps away, the shadow slides to the other boy
details: pale boy with a stolen shadow
scenes.camera: high-angle drift down and in, handheld
scenes.sound_cue: dry scrape as the shadow slides, sub swell into a hit

scenes.subject: The narrator in the foreground alone and shadowless while Mummy hugs the pale boy at the gate and the other children walk off to a door

layers.foreground: narrator seen from behind with no shadow
layers.midground: the pale boy walking to Mummy in a pink sari, children leaving
layers.background: school wall with a gate arch and a wooden door

scenes.light_source: low afternoon sun, long shadows on everyone but the narrator
scenes.motion: slow push, children walk away, the boy walks to the gate, the hug
details: the boy carrying the narrator's red bag
scenes.withheld: his face as nobody sees him
scenes.camera: slow push from behind the narrator, handheld
scenes.sound_cue: wet bare footslaps, children walking away, cloth rustle at the hug

scenes.subject: The narrator alone in the empty courtyard with no shadow, his hand raised, wet footprints appearing and evaporating at his feet

layers.midground: the narrator facing the camera, hand raised

scenes.light_source: low bleached afternoon sun with no shadow cast
scenes.motion: low crawl tilting up to reveal him, footprints appear and evaporate, shimmer
scenes.withheld: whether anyone will take his hand
scenes.sound_cue: drips and hiss on hot stone, a reversed swell into the loop
